about.p1: {brand} is a place to share your nice ideas — short thoughts, long reads, photos and audio — as a single link.
about.p2: Anyone can open a shared link, with or without an account. Posts can come straight from apps such as NiceNote, or be written on the web.
about.p3: Your posts stay yours: you can edit or withdraw them at any time, and withdrawn posts are permanently deleted after 30 days.
about.title: About

guidelines.intro: Help keep {brand} a friendly place for ideas. Posts and comments must not:
guidelines.item1: break the law or infringe other people's rights, including copyright and privacy;
guidelines.item2: harass, threaten or promote hatred against anyone;
guidelines.item3: contain sexual content involving minors or graphic violence;
guidelines.outro: Content that breaks these rules may be removed, and repeat offenders may lose access. Use Report on a post to tell us about a problem.
guidelines.title: Community guidelines

help.a1: Share a note from NiceNote, or write a post on the web once web publishing opens.
help.a2: Edit the note in the app and the post updates. Withdraw it in the app and the link stops working right away.
help.a3: Anyone with the link. Posts also appear on your profile and in feeds.
help.a4: Use Report on the post. We review every report.
